def: to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety)
kjv: avoid, eschew, go out of the way

occurrences.text: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
